phase: Phase 27: Unified Hardware Bridge Integration & System Certification

stories.title: Tactical Snapshots, Multi-Radio & Rekeying Hardware Bridge Wiring
stories.description: Wire TacticalSnapshotProtocol, MultiRadioArbiter, and GroupRekeyProtocol into IntercomHardwareBridge and iOS IntercomBridge.kt. Exposes reactive snapshots (SnapshotTransferProgress, ActiveRadioMode, RekeyEpochState) with CancellationHandle observers on iOS, ensuring full bridge integration for visual telemetry, Wi-Fi Direct offloading, and forward-secret group key rotation.
acceptanceCriteria: IntercomHardwareBridge exposes reactive StateFlows for SnapshotTransferProgress, RadioMode, and RekeyEpochState
IntercomBridge.kt exposes typed Swift-friendly observeSnapshotProgress, observeRadioMode, and observeRekeyState returning CancellationHandle (Rule 1)
Zero Java or C dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator compilation (Rule 6)

stories.title: Satellite Lifeline, Alpine Coded PHY & Wearable Companion Bridge Wiring
stories.description: Wire SatelliteGatewayBridge, AdaptivePhyArbiter, and WearableCompanionProtocol into IntercomHardwareBridge and iOS IntercomBridge.kt. Exposes reactive states for satellite uplink beacons, BLE PHY negotiation (LE 1M, 2M, Coded S=8), and smartwatch companion telemetry (quick-PTT, heart rate, rider fall detection) with typed observers.
acceptanceCriteria: IntercomHardwareBridge exposes reactive SatelliteBridgeSnapshot, PhyNegotiationSnapshot, and WearableCompanionSnapshot
IntercomBridge.kt exposes observeSatelliteStatus, observePhyMode, and observeWearableVitals with CancellationHandle lifecycle bindings
Subsystem hooks for triggering satellite distress beacon and wearable PTT clicks
100% unit test pass across all platforms

stories.title: Spectral Noise DSP, Wake Word VOX & Airtime Congestion Governor Bridge Wiring
stories.description: Wire SpectralNoiseSuppressor, AcousticWakeWordEngine, and AirtimeCongestionGovernor into IntercomHardwareBridge and iOS IntercomBridge.kt. Exposes reactive snapshots for real-time wind noise dB attenuation, hands-free VOX state machine transitions, and channel busy ratio (CBR) congestion levels with adaptive FEC indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: IntercomHardwareBridge exposes reactive SpectralNoiseSnapshot, VoxStateSnapshot, and AirtimeCongestionSnapshot
IntercomBridge.kt exposes observeNoiseSuppression, observeVoxState, and observeCongestionLevel with CancellationHandle bindings
Subsystem hooks for switching noise suppression profiles and tuning VOX sensitivity
100% unit test pass across all platforms

stories.title: 32-Node Unified End-to-End System Simulation, Final Architecture Showcase & Certification
stories.description: Implement UnifiedSystemCertificationHarness.kt simulating 32 full-stack nodes exercising all interconnected subsystems (mesh flooding, AODV-Lite, multi-group federation, 4-tier QoS, failover hedging, snapshots, satellite lifeline, Coded PHY, spectral noise suppression, hands-free wake word, and congestion governance). Updates Archify showcase with 9/9 verification pass and signs off core development completion.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 32 nodes traversing high-speed alpine expedition conditions with all 9 core feature domains active
Verifies end-to-end voice latency <= 80ms, zero dropped emergency frames, and complete hardware bridge synchronization
Archify architecture specification and HTML showcase updated with 9/9 verification checks passed
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets certifying end of core development
